newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-NATWEST TROPHY SEMIFINAL CLOSE SCORE.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-NATWEST TROPHY SEMIFINAL CLOSE SCORE.

text.p: Bad light forced an end to play in the NatWest Trophy semifinal between Essex and Glamorgan on Tuesday.
Scores: Glamorgan 301-8 innings closed (60 overs), Essex 296-8 off 53.1 overs (S.Law 90, D.Robinson 62, R.Irani 51).
Match resumes on Wednesday with Essex requiring six runs to win.
Warwickshire and Sussex play their semifinal on Wednesday also.
